'''Jerry Yeager''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 14th at [[June 2001 Marlton tournament]] on 3 June 2001, according to Greg Shaw's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2409">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-04-marlton-nj-06-03-01d2409/ marlton-nj-06-03-01], DeckTech (Greg "TychoCelchu" Shaw, 4 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-04-marlton-nj-06-03-01d2409/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
